name: Nebraska Open 2010
information: The first [World Cube Association](http://www.worldcubeassociation.org/) Rubik's Cube competition is coming to Nebraska. This competition is opened to all competitors regardless of age or nationality. All competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](http://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [Competitor Tutorial](http://www.cubingusa.com/ctutorial.php).
